mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Over at Fireman's Park, we are sitting at 38 degrees under overcast skies, with a real-feel of 27 degrees and a waning gibbous moon overnight. The overnight temperature will dip to 32 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, candidate information packets are now available for the 2027 Spring Election. Seats across all four City of Verona Aldermanic Districts will be on the ballot. Interested candidates must submit their required forms to the City Clerk by 5 PM on January 5th, 2027, with nomination papers requiring between 20 and 40 valid signatures.

There are plenty of community events lined up! Today, you can attend Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy ART House 360 Thursday Nights, or play Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, check out live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or celebrate 50 years of craft brewing at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead to Saturday, November 28th, head over to ART House 360 for The Crafty Fair.

From the police recap, on Wednesday, November 4th, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash in a parking lot on East Verona Avenue, resulting in the arrest of a 34-year-old driver for an O W I with a minor passenger.
Ending on a sweet note, Culver's is currently open tonight until 10:00 PM. Be sure to check in today or swing by tomorrow when they feature Snickers Swirl as the flavor of the day.
